title: Finite group actions and invariant quotients of fs log schemes
statement:
Let $H$ be a finite group and $X$ an fs log scheme, with log morphisms as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. An $H$-action on $X$ consists of log automorphisms $a_g:X\to X$ with $a_1=\operatorname{id}$ and $a_{gh}=a_g\circ a_h$. It is tame if for every geometric point $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$, with $\Omega$ algebraically closed, the order of $\{g\in H:a_gx=x\}$ is invertible in $\Omega$. It is generically free if there is a dense invariant open $U\subset X$ such that every geometric point in $U$ has trivial stabilizer. A log morphism $f:X\to Y$ between schemes with $H$-actions is equivariant when $f a_g=a_g f$ for every $g$.

For an fs log scheme $Y$, a log morphism $q:X\to Y$ is the invariant log quotient if its underlying scheme morphism is invariant, its topology is the orbit quotient topology, it is categorical among invariant scheme morphisms, and for every affine open $U\subset Y$ its preimage is affine and the canonical ring map identifies $\mathcal O_Y(U)$ with $\mathcal O_X(q^{-1}U)^H$; moreover, for every etale $E\to Y$, the canonical log pullback map identifies $M_Y(E)$ with the invariant submonoid of $M_X(E\times_YX)$. Here the $H$-action on $E\times_YX$ is the identity on $E$ and the given action on $X$, and the invariance is tested using the given action on log sections. Thus $M_Y=(q_*M_X)^H$, with its prescribed structural map.
